text: At its meeting held March 25 and 26, 2026, City Council considered Item CA33.2 - Appointment of a Public Member to the Exhibition Place Board, and appointed Sharleen Ahmed to the Exhibition Place Board of Governors for a term of office starting March 28, 2026 and ending March 28, 2030, and until a successor is appointed.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place received the item for information.
